results.description:
Why is Min Aung Hlaing pushing so hard to revive Myitsone Dam?

He claims it’ll fix chronic blackouts, but under the contract, almost all the power gets exported straight to China. And how on earth does a bankrupt regime plan to repay massive debt for it?
